english.toefl: 90 for June 1, 2025–January 20, 2026 tests; 5 overall with 4.5 Speaking/Writing for tests from January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS Academic/Online: tests from January 21, 2026 also require 6.5 Speaking and Writing. Tests before June 1, 2025 are invalid for Fall 2027. No Duolingo, TOEFL ITP/MyBest, IELTS Indicator or One Test Retake. Exemptions cover qualifying English-country basic degrees, accredited US degrees, or a completed full-time US academic year with B grades; English-medium foreign study alone is insufficient.

documents: Statement of purpose (one to two pages)

applicationFee.note: US citizens/permanent residents pay $135; central policy adds 4.22% processing. Financial-need waivers are limited to US citizens/permanent residents.

requirements.note: Bachelor’s equivalent, normally GPA 3.0 under central policy. At least two letters must be from science faculty familiar with scholarly/research abilities; late/additional letters not accepted. Upload original non-English records with translations. Only one Berkeley program per term; Plant Biology and Microbiology are separate choices.

funding.note: All admitted students receive five years of funding, tuition and fees contingent on satisfactory progress. The approximately $52,000 estimate is for 2026–2027, not confirmed Fall 2027.

international.note: Department generally admits one international student per program per year; outside-fellowship holders may be considered with domestic applicants.

sources.label: Application materials and separate degree choices
